exemplars.description: DRAFT: Build provenance: what was built, from which exact inputs, by which process.

why.traceability: DRAFT: Every input is listed with its digest.
why.reproducibility: DRAFT: The build process and its parameters are recorded.

exemplars.description: DRAFT: Attestations: a signed statement that names its subject by digest and what it claims about it.

why.traceability: DRAFT: The subject is named by its digest.

exemplars.description: DRAFT: A lockfile: the exact resolved version and integrity hash of every dependency.

why.traceability: DRAFT: Every dependency carries its exact version and integrity hash.
why.reproducibility: DRAFT: The same install can be made again from the lockfile.

exemplars.description: DRAFT: A bill of materials: every component a release contains, once, with its version and hash.

why.traceability: DRAFT: One entry per component, with its version.

exemplars.description: DRAFT: Version numbers that say what kind of change a release holds.

why.change-clarity: DRAFT: The version itself says what kind of change shipped.

exemplars.description: DRAFT: A changelog that lists only what changed in each release, grouped by kind of change.

why.change-clarity: DRAFT: Only the changes, release by release.

exemplars.description: DRAFT: Generated release notes: the changes between this release and the previous one, computed from history.

why.change-clarity: DRAFT: The diff against the previous release is computed, not written by hand.
why.reproducibility: DRAFT: Notes are derived from the recorded history.
